# World Meteorological Organization (WMO)

> The UN's authoritative voice on weather, climate, and water, providing global meteorological services, early warning systems, and Earth system science coordination.

WMO is a specialized UN agency with 193 member states and territories, headquartered in Geneva. It coordinates international meteorological and hydrological services, climate monitoring, and disaster risk reduction through regional associations and global initiatives.

## Key Topics

- World Meteorological Organization (WMO)
- Early Warnings for All
- Meteorology and Hydrology
- Climate Monitoring
- Extreme Weather and Typhoons
- Regional Associations
- Global Atmosphere Watch (GAW)
- Renewable Energy Transition
- Member States
- Weather Alerts and Early Warning Systems
- International Cooperation
- Executive Council
- El Niño and La Niña
- Disaster Risk Reduction
- Celeste Saulo (Secretary-General)
